_comment: Machine-readable twin of assessment/01-audit.md. The release gate blocks on any open P0/P1 here. status: open | fixed | accepted. An accepted risk needs owner, mitigation, accepted_by and expires (YYYY-MM-DD).

risks.title: The API cannot boot the way production boots it
risks.impact: Everyone: the service crash-loops on deploy; nothing works.
risks.mitigation: None until fixed. Development and test never eager-load, so nobody saw it.
risks.fix: Declared the two WebSocket middleware names to the autoloader (config/initializers/zeitwerk.rb).

risks.title: The invite link sent to candidates points at the API host
risks.impact: Candidates: the link opens a server error page, so no interview can start from an invite.
risks.mitigation: A developer can hand-edit the host in each link. An assessor cannot know to.
risks.fix: Invite links are built from WEB_BASE_URL; production refuses to boot without it.

risks.title: Any tenant can read, export and overwrite another tenant's candidate results by id
risks.impact: Client tenants and candidates: ratings and evidence leak across companies and can be changed by a stranger.
risks.mitigation: None. Ids are sequential integers.
risks.fix: Portfolio.for_tenant / PortfolioSkill.for_tenant; every controller lookup by id goes through them, and a structural spec fails on the next bare lookup.

risks.title: A login is not tied to any organization; the caller picks the tenant with a header
risks.impact: Client tenants: any assessor account can obtain a valid token for any other company.
risks.mitigation: None. The users table has no organization.
risks.fix: users.organization_id; the login token is scoped to the account's organization and the request header is ignored.

risks.title: Skills that were never assessed are stored and shown as real ratings (usually L1)
risks.impact: Candidates and hiring managers: a fabricated low rating reads as a measured gap and drives the fit/gap result.
risks.mitigation: None. The schema cannot represent 'not assessed', so the code invents a level.
risks.fix: ai_level is nullable and never defaulted; the generator decides what is stored from the assessment and the coverage map; the web renders 'Not assessed'.

risks.title: Confidence is whatever the model says, not the rule the PRD defines
risks.impact: Hiring managers: a rating can show HIGH confidence for a skill probed once.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.fix: Confidence is computed from the coverage map by the PRD rule; the model's own confidence is ignored.

risks.title: Any dropped connection silently ends the interview two minutes later, even after the candidate rejoined
risks.impact: Candidates: the interview keeps running on screen while the stored session is already ended as failed and rated from a truncated transcript.
risks.mitigation: None. A network blip or page refresh is enough.
risks.fix: The newest audio connection records itself on the session; a dropped connection's grace timer ends the interview only if it is still that connection.

risks.title: Anyone holding an invite link can end the session, and it is recorded as 'all skills covered'
risks.impact: Assessors: a never-started interview shows as completed; a cut-short interview is stored as fully covered.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.fix: audio_complete refuses a session that never started (409) and records the end reason from stored coverage and time instead of assuming all_covered.

risks.title: Removing a skill in the assessment or vacancy edit form does not remove it
risks.impact: Assessors: the screen shows the skill gone; the AI still interviews on it and the fit/gap still requires it.
risks.mitigation: None from the UI.
risks.fix: On update the submitted skill list is the list: stored skills missing from it are removed. A request that omits the list leaves it untouched.

risks.title: Clicking a level label on one skill changes a different skill's level
risks.impact: Assessors: required levels are saved against the wrong skill, so fit/gap results are computed against wrong requirements.
risks.mitigation: Clicking the radio circle instead of its label works.
risks.fix: Each level picker generates its own ids, so a label belongs to exactly one radio.

risks.title: A fit/gap report is served unchanged after the vacancy's requirements change
risks.impact: Hiring managers: a decision is read from a report computed against requirements that no longer exist.
risks.mitigation: Press Regenerate, if you know the vacancy changed.
risks.fix: A report knows when it is stale (vacancy or portfolio newer than the report) and is then regenerated instead of served, on trigger, read and export.

risks.title: No evidence that a live AI interview works on this build: PRD-01 section 7 says engineers must test the failure modes, and nothing does
risks.impact: Everyone: the product's main function is unverified end to end; defects in that path are found by reading, not by running.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Run the scripted interview in assessment/uat-live-interview.md against staging with model credentials and attach the transcript.
risks.evidence: No test, recording or eval exists in the repo, the tracker or the wiki.

risks.title: Evidence quotes are not checked against the transcript
risks.impact: Hiring managers: a quote the model invented would be shown as 'Evidence from interview'.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: The transcript is one click away for cross-checking. Measure the invention rate during the R-12 run before choosing a rule.
risks.evidence: By reading api/app/services/portfolios/generator.rb; not observed, no model access.

risks.title: Tenant scoping fails open: with no tenant resolved, queries return every tenant's rows
risks.impact: Client tenants: the next endpoint or job that forgets the tenant leaks everything instead of nothing.
risks.owner: Tech lead (to be named at G3 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Every authenticated request requires a resolved tenant today, and AC-SEC-04 guards the tenant-less tables. Workers and sockets rely on the open default, so closing it is a planned refactor.

risks.title: The live coverage socket accepts any validly signed token, whatever its role
risks.impact: Client tenants: a non-assessor account of the same tenant can watch a live interview's coverage.
risks.owner: Tech lead (to be named at G3 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Limited to the caller's own tenant.

risks.title: Editing an assessment after interviews were held rewrites what they were held against
risks.impact: Assessors: the definition a past result was judged against is no longer recoverable.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Stored ratings do not change. Avoid editing an assessment that has sessions; duplicate it instead.
risks.evidence: By reading; no document defines edit semantics once sessions exist.

risks.title: Invite links never expire and work for anyone who has them
risks.impact: Candidates and assessors: a forwarded or leaked link lets someone else take or disturb the interview.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Tokens are 256-bit random; ended sessions refuse new connections.

risks.title: The time limit is only enforced when someone speaks
risks.impact: Operations: a silent, connected session is never ended by the server.
risks.mitigation: The browser ends the interview when its own timer expires.

risks.title: A candidate is told 'Interview Complete, recorded' when the link is invalid, the page failed to load, or the connection was lost
risks.impact: Candidates: they believe they finished an interview that never happened or failed, and do not retry or ask.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.fix: The page has a 'failed' state: a bad link, a failed load, an error end and exhausted reconnects each say what happened and what to do; 'Interview Complete' follows only a session the server ended normally.

risks.title: A failed portfolio regeneration destroys the existing ratings and assessor overrides
risks.impact: Assessors: human review work is lost with no trace.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.fix: Regeneration replaces skills inside one transaction; a failure restores the previous ratings and overrides.

risks.title: Deleting an assessment that has sessions answers 'deleted' and deletes nothing
risks.impact: API consumers: the response contradicts the stored data.
risks.mitigation: No screen calls delete today.
risks.fix: DELETE answers 409 with the model's reason when nothing was deleted.

risks.title: The fit/gap table shows an empty Required column and never marks overrides
risks.impact: Hiring managers: the report's main table is missing half its comparison.
risks.mitigation: The result badge and the PDF export still show the comparison.
risks.fix: The API marks overrides (is_override) and the web reads expected_level, the field the API actually sends; both sides are pinned to contracts/fit_gap_report.json.

risks.title: Unknown API routes raise a framework error; the ticket for it was closed as completed with no change
risks.impact: API consumers and the audit trail: a 'done' ticket describes work that never shipped.
risks.mitigation: None needed for users.
risks.fix: A catch-all route answers JSON 404 for any path the API does not serve.

risks.title: A session with no portfolio reports 'generating' forever
risks.impact: Assessors: an endless spinner for an interview that has not ended.
risks.mitigation: Only reachable by URL today.
risks.fix: A session with no portfolio answers 404 not_available; the page says the interview has not ended.

risks.title: A wrong password reloads the login page instead of showing the error
risks.impact: Assessors: no feedback on a failed login.
risks.mitigation: Retype and try again.
risks.fix: The 401 handler leaves a rejected login attempt to the form; it still signs out on a rejected session token.

risks.title: A courtesy phrase from the AI ('good luck', 'thank you for your time') ends the interview
risks.impact: Candidates: an interview can be cut short mid-way on a phrase match.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.fix: A closing phrase ends the interview only when the AI had a reason to close: skills covered or a wrap-up signalled.

risks.title: The web app had no lockfile, so a release build could differ from what was tested
risks.impact: Everyone: an untested dependency version can ship.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.evidence: web/package-lock.json was absent from the source.
risks.fix: web/package-lock.json is committed and CI installs with npm ci; a gate test fails if it goes missing or drifts from the manifest.

risks.title: Deploy manifests are not release-ready: image tag 'latest', the worker runs as 'staging' beside a 'production' API, and no manifest provides the secrets the app needs
risks.impact: Operations: what runs cannot be traced to a released version.
risks.owner: Tech lead (to be named at G3 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Do not apply these manifests as they are. Pin the image to the release tag at deploy time.
risks.evidence: By reading api/k8s/*.yaml; no cluster access.

risks.title: Calls to the analysis model are configured to retry but never do
risks.impact: Assessors: a transient model error fails a portfolio or coverage update immediately.
risks.mitigation: Sidekiq retries the portfolio job three times.
risks.evidence: By reading api/app/clients/gemini/http_client.rb against the retry middleware defaults; not run.

risks.title: A fresh setup has no user to log in with, and the signup screen calls an endpoint that does not exist
risks.impact: New engineers: the documented setup cannot reach a logged-in state.
risks.mitigation: Create a user from the Rails console.

risks.title: Setup does not work as documented: bin stubs are not executable, and the web app's default API address is a port the API does not listen on
risks.impact: New engineers: the documented commands fail and a default setup cannot reach the API.
risks.mitigation: Use 'bundle exec'. The API port is 3001.
risks.evidence: quality/gate/gate.test.mjs; found by running the net's own documented command
risks.fix: bin stubs carry the executable bit; the web defaults, .env.example and README name the API's real port; a gate test holds both.

risks.title: Creating an assessment answers 'system_prompt_generated: true' before the prompt exists, in a different shape from update
risks.impact: API consumers: a client that trusts the flag starts an interview with no prompt.
risks.mitigation: The audio socket compiles a missing prompt on connect.

risks.title: The fit/gap page re-queues generation on every poll and has no failed state
risks.impact: Operations and assessors: duplicate model calls, and an endless spinner if generation fails.
risks.mitigation: Reload the page.

risks.title: A skill is promoted to 'covered' on probe count alone, which PRD-01 section 4 does not allow
risks.impact: Hiring managers: 'covered' and therefore HIGH confidence can be reached without the evidence test.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: Promotion needs at least four exchanges on the skill.

risks.title: Transcript turns are written on background threads and write errors are swallowed
risks.impact: Hiring managers: a transcript can be missing turns with no signal, and ratings are generated from it.
risks.mitigation: Errors are logged.

risks.title: No feature had acceptance criteria, a design plan, or any test before this audit
risks.impact: Everyone: nobody could say whether a feature was correct. The criteria written here are the auditor's reading and need product sign-off.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: docs/specs/acceptance-criteria.md now holds reviewable criteria; the gate requires them for every runtime change.
risks.evidence: The wiki holds two narrative PRDs; the repo had no spec directory and no tests.

risks.title: Shipped behaviour with no spec at all: login and users, the tenancy model, candidate consent and recording retention, export contents, rate limits, the 10-minute time limit
risks.impact: Clients and candidates: a voice interview is recorded and sent to a third-party model with no consent step or retention rule defined.
risks.owner: Product owner (to be named at G2 sign-off)
risks.mitigation: None. Needs a product and legal decision before client data is processed.
risks.evidence: No document covers these; the code is the only statement of intent.

risks.title: Ending the interview while the connection is down shows 'Interview Complete' although the server was never told
risks.impact: Candidates and assessors: the candidate sees a completed interview; the stored session stays active and is ended as failed two minutes later.
risks.mitigation: None.
risks.fix: The end is reported over HTTP when the socket is down; if that fails too, the page reports the interview was not completed.
